description: Commit a deploy started with `deploy_create_upload`. Pass the `versionId` from the start response and a `completions` array containing the agent-collected ETags for each multi-part file (single-part uploads - those whose start response had an empty `uploadId` - do not need a completion entry). Returns the live site URL on success. The site must belong to the authenticated user; bearer-token auth is re-validated server-side, so holding presigned URLs alone does not let an unrelated caller finalize.

completions.description: Completions for multi-part uploads. Omit or pass an empty array if every file was single-part.

key.description: S3 object key from the start response's `files[fileName].key`.

parts.description: ETag + PartNumber for every uploaded part of this file.

ETag.description: ETag header value from the corresponding PUT response (include surrounding quotes if S3 returned them).

PartNumber.description: Part number matching `partUploadUrls[i].part` from the start response.

uploadId.description: S3 multipart upload ID from the start response's `files[fileName].uploadId`.

partition.description: Data partition the site lives in. Omit to use the user's home partition.

siteId.description: The site ID being deployed to (must match the start call).

name: deploy_finalize
